tool: Creatify current pricing and credit economics

criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official FAQ supports Amazon/product links and uploaded product images/videos; exact identity in the first 10 seconds is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No saved AIVP output tied to the current plans.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Official FAQ documents a precise editor and revisions; cross-run product drift remains untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Product URL/media input, scripting, ad generation and editing are documented, but current-plan end-to-end friction is unmeasured.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No current queue, render-time or failure artifacts.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Plan prices and API/app credit schedules are published, but documentation conflicts by surface and cost per accepted output is unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: FAQ states user ownership, unrestricted channels and royalty-free stock; input rights and model-specific edge cases still apply.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Official API billing and pricing-page MCP listing establish integration paths; production credentials and cost gates are not audited here.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Browser-based free/creator plans fit SMB evaluation; AUD billing and tax are not documented.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: AIVP has active verified tracking and Creatify publicly advertises 25% recurring commission.

analysis: Current pricing is material to buyers and AIVP affiliate content, but a pricing snapshot does not verify product quality. Conflicting app/API credit units make real cost per usable video a required test.
confidence_notes: Primary pricing/help/API/affiliate documents only for this event; no controlled current-plan run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Not approved until all three runs preserve exact ASIN identity in the first 10 seconds.
hard_gates.publication: Pricing facts may be corrected, but no quality/ranking uplift without hands-on evidence.
hard_gates.integration: Existing tool only; no new MCP deployment without security and cost-gate audit.
